instructions: Make the protagonist's immediate want, the opposing force, the change in value, and the consequence observable in the planned material.
Prefer causal transitions and meaningful ellipsis over connective events that add no turn.
Give each step a narrative function and preserve readable spatial and emotional causality across the sequence.
Use reaction, detail, and transition coverage to show consequence instead of explaining it outside the image.
Bind every planned generated or AI-enhanced shot to a concrete narrative beat and the approved causal order.
Imported footage remains production truth and is not forced into invented execution details.
Verify that the cut makes context, action, and consequence legible without explanatory prose.
Judge emotional truth before lower-order spatial neatness when the two genuinely conflict.

machineRules.message: Narrative generated and AI-enhanced shots require a declared beat.
Narrative sequences should make context, action, and consequence visible.

provenance.adaptation: Distilled into format-neutral narrative guidance and structural predicates without selecting a format container.
